    The deck grading of a scalar mesh category, as a graded family #

    Subsection 4.2 (scalar-normalization.tex): the covering formula eq:walk-hom-sum and the height. For a translation quiver with homogeneous meshes, the walk-class weight deg of DeckGrading.lean grades the Hom spaces of C(Q, c) between all vertices (deckGrading), and the length of walk classes is a height in the sense of HeightData (deckHeight): nonzero morphisms of degree g are combinations of paths of length ℓ(g), and in length zero only identities occur.
